scores.reason: Source shows dedicated student fit: /for-students, recordHint to start with projects/internships/volunteering/coursework and label academic work, suggestedRoles Graduate business analyst/Operations intern/Junior data analyst, claim kinds academic_project/internship/volunteering/education/skill, and question 'Was this coursework or paid work?' Free CV-to-vacancy check with PDF/DOCX/TXT downloads addresses first-application need. Gaps: requires existing CV text plus pasted JD; thin records likely yield many gaps; no live internship coverage or outcomes demonstrated.

Source shows low-friction entry: Try one CV check without signup, Start my free Job Loop with audience carrying into setup, six steps Pick role/Bring CV/Add vacancy/Read evidence/Make it yours/Approve & download, editable preferences with no years/credentials inferred. Friction: /dashboard and /loop redirect to /auth when signed out, profile form has many fields (target roles, locations, experienceYears, languages, compensation, discreetSearch), pilot capped at 10 accounts. No observed signup completion or guidance effectiveness.

Code includes accessible patterns: main landmarks, aria labels, role=status loading, labelled selects, titled PDF iframe, heading focus plus scrollIntoView on step change, error/notice regions. No observed layout, mobile, or assistive-tech behavior in package. Intake limited to text-based PDF/DOCX/TXT <=5MB with scanned PDFs/.doc requiring conversion, hurting phone-scanned student docs; DOCX/TXT layout depends on reader. Cannot confirm coherent mobile experience.

Source implements conservative model: local heuristic comparison with ACTUAL_VERB/WEAKENED/PENDING/NEGATIVE, deadline/condition separated as review, dated-qualification handling, per-requirement explanation plus question, complete literal source-passage preservation including negation/contribution, context must be nearby literal label, dual approval (facts plus privacy/disclosure), exact PDF-bytes preview with page-target gate, evidence report separate from CV, relevance labeled heuristic not ATS/eligibility. Limits: English-text comparison only, unsupported-script self-review fallback, no observed typography or employer acceptance.

Demonstrated relevance path is manual: paste one JD with responsibilities/requirements; opportunities typed manual/employer_api/web_search with verification states. Discovery depends on optional Tavily search requiring JOB_LOOP_TAVILY_API_KEY plus paid APIs (basic 5-result queries) and referenced employer feeds with no coverage shown, plus role/location matching that filters senior/junior/graduate/intern terms. Only three example student titles; EXPERIENCE_REQUIREMENT_GAP can exclude discovery prep. No live internship/graduate listings or location coverage demonstrated.

Free check and rules mode run without external AI using confirmed facts; model use limited to selecting claimIds (<=16, eligible/unique) with no generated factual text accepted; packets compose from shareable facts. Student effort stays high: supply CV, paste JD, inspect findings, add only accurate examples, enforce 1-page limit, dual-confirm, download, submit on employer site, manually track. Recurring preparation needs explicit opt-in plus configured scheduler; UI warns 'Recurring execution is not currently available'; worker may need resume. No time savings observed.

Source shows manual tracking structure: statuses saved/prepared/applied/interview/offer/rejected/withdrawn, followUpAt with due/upcoming filtering via loopFollowUpDue, deadline requirements with closing-date timezone question, overview stages and next-action cards, next-run/last-attempt/run-history reporting, FAQ that tracker records self-reported progress and link-open is not submission. Gaps: status/follow-up appear self-reported with no observed reminders, notifications, calendar integration, or demonstrated mutation persistence. Partial actionability with uncertainty.

Code shows defensive flows: ErrorBoundary/Suspense, QueryClient retry 1, 30-min in-memory draft recovery with sessionStorage only after explicit consent and owner binding, clear on account change/refresh/close/sign-out, requestId idempotency with 409 on conflicting facts, resume/cancel run, stale-input 409 requiring rebuild before approval, model/search unusable-result errors, PDF font/unsupported-char fallbacks to DOCX/TXT. Limits: unsaved edits lost on refresh without consent, pilot subject to run limits/availability, support receipt means recorded not reviewed with no promised time, no live failure rates demonstrated.

Source shows explicit control: saving career record is explicit choice to private Supabase account; unsaved edits in tab memory <=30 min not browser storage; bounded recovery limits; per-run choice of rules vs consented Claude/OpenAI/Kimi with only shareable facts plus vacancy text sent not raw CV; Google sign-in is not inbox access, Gmail needs separate permission, drafts need recipient/attachment approval, no send/submit action, disconnect removes credentials; original file stays on device; corrections require re-review, cannot recall downloaded file. Gaps: student must self-redact, deletion/erasure flow not demonstrated.

Explicitly qualified persona inference, not purchase research. Source pricing: Free Starter (free check, PDF/DOCX/TXT downloads, optional saving/tracking) ready now; Focus $15/mo and Job Loop $29/mo are proposed future tiers with checkout unavailable, pilot free for 10 accounts with no card/conversion, and explicit no interview/employment guarantee. Cash-constrained student with seasonal internship applications likely uses free check and hesitates at $15-29/mo without proven listings, automation, or outcomes. No purchase demand or paid entitlement demonstrated.

actions.action: Ship a guided first-CV starter for students that turns prompted academic projects and volunteering into editable source text with contribution and measured/projected/not_measured labels.
actions.acceptanceCriterion: A signed-out student with no CV file can complete <=10 guided prompts (project/internship/volunteering, contribution, result status) to create validated sourceText that passes validateCvText, maps to academic_project/internship/volunteering claim kinds, and reaches evidence review without external paste in a scripted test.

actions.action: Make internship/graduate vacancy sourcing transparent with explicit availability states and one-click manual capture fallback.
actions.acceptanceCriterion: Opportunities panel displays search and employer-feed configured vs not-configured status with last-checked time, up to 5 source-linked results with verification labels (user_provided/listed_on_source/unverified), and manual JD paste fallback; when unconfigured it states manual-only with no implied coverage.

actions.action: Reduce one-page and mobile-intake friction with inline length guidance and early file-validation errors for text-based PDF/DOCX/TXT only.
actions.acceptanceCriterion: During CV editing the student sees live length estimate and shorten/omit hints that achieve a 1-page PDF preview within selected pageTarget on retry; oversize >5MB, scanned PDF, or .doc inputs show a specific conversion error before analysis in <=2 steps.

actions.action: Strengthen deadline and follow-up actionability so multiple internship applications keep a visible next action and persisted manual tracker state.
actions.acceptanceCriterion: Each opportunity persists status (saved/prepared/applied/interview/offer/rejected/withdrawn), followUpAt, and notes; workspace shows due vs upcoming sorted lists and deadline timezone prompt, and updates remain after reload in the same authenticated account snapshot.

actions.action: Publish and implement verifiable retention and deletion controls for student records and saved checks.
actions.acceptanceCriterion: Workspace provides confirmed delete for saved checks and career-record data with post-delete list verification, documents what is removed versus retained approved docs, and privacy support requests return a trackable reference showing recorded status.

strengths: Student-specific record path that starts with projects, internships, volunteering and coursework, preserves academic vs paid-work context, and defaults to one page with editable roles.
Free six-step CV check without signup offering requirement-by-requirement evidence, exact PDF preview, and approved PDF/DOCX/TXT downloads plus separate evidence report.
Anti-invention document model requiring complete literal source-passage preservation, nearby literal context, dual fact plus disclosure approvals, and explicit heuristic-not-ATS disclaimers.
Granular privacy and control with explicit save choice, 30-minute tab-memory recovery, per-run model consent limited to shareable facts, and separate Gmail permission with no auto-send.
Stale-input and hold protections that invalidate approval when record or vacancy changes, clear old previews, and require rebuild and re-review before download.
weaknesses: Internship/graduate discovery unproven; primary demonstrated path is manual paste of one JD, with web search and employer feeds gated by configuration and basic 5-result search.
High manual effort for novices: supply CV plus JD, interpret gaps, shorten to page limit, approve, submit externally, manually update tracker; recurring runs flagged as not currently available.
Mobile, accessibility, and file handling unverified; text-based PDF/DOCX/TXT <=5MB only with scanned PDFs/.doc excluded and no observed mobile layout or assistive-tech validation.
Live reliability unproven under 10-account free pilot with scheduler/worker availability caveats, resume flows, and support receipt without promised review time.
Limited paid relevance for students: checkout disabled, Focus $15 and Loop $29 are proposals only, with explicit no interview/employment guarantee and likely seasonal use.
